review_kind: internal independent preparation review, not external approval

checks.name: source_snapshot_binding
checks.basis: All 197 current science source hashes are frozen; imports are constrained to that snapshot, live/historical science imports rejected.

checks.name: default_scientific_path
checks.basis: Original formal default Recorder and diagnostic solver checked; no injected optimizer or recorder.

checks.name: whole_builder_flags
checks.basis: partial(builder, extra) plus original warm FLAGS yields all K193 whole flags with no fixed deployment, neighborhood, cumulative precedence or preelimination.

checks.name: actual_y_guard
checks.basis: validate_model runs after original build and before session startup; original build emits 72 Stage y integers, implied-binary auxiliary variables kept continuous.

checks.name: ready_schema
checks.basis: Historical R2023b ready.json accepted directly by pure ready validator.

checks.name: native_option_schema
checks.basis: Historical original raw request/response shape accepted after substituting only mock 300s time allocations; all other original options exact.

checks.name: old_budget_not_reusable
checks.basis: Historical 3600s allocation correctly rejected, not reused as current execution evidence.

checks.name: cut_and_cap
checks.basis: Original bridge cut=10; no native solver_max_time cap supplied by entry; readback checks each response.

checks.name: budget_scope
checks.basis: MethodBudget starts before fresh case I/O, L0/model/init/MATLAB/solve and internal thermal checks share 300s. Imports and cleanup remain separately billed in calendar as P0 convention.

checks.name: no_enum_initialization
checks.basis: Search consumes frozen input/config only; reference.json is hashed at plan preparation but no enumeration candidate or receipt is passed into method.

checks.name: unprepared_and_disabled
checks.basis: This review does not create human authorization or an execution claim; actual launch remains separately gated.

checks.name: fixture_scope
checks.basis: Observed existing 82-test transcript is pure mock/static coverage, not original numerical-model construction or native success.

old_ready_record_direct.scope: already-read worker identity only; no native launch

old_native_options_with_only_mock_timing.scope: readback identity and allocation only; not solver success or certification

native_shape_fixtures.source: Existing K187 request/response field shapes; no request resubmitted and no candidate evaluated

nonblocking_limits: Ready check binds release R2023b, successful checkout, solver availability and frozen executable hash; it does not independently hash every installed toolbox file. Do not describe this as byte identity of all MATLAB toolbox files.

Pure metadata fakes and source review do not prove an actual original small-domain numerical model can be constructed, initialized or solved. These remain inside the separately approved single method invocation.
